summary: ClearSign Technologies filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an underwriting agreement with Newbridge Securities for a firm-commitment public offering of 777,780 common shares at $4.33 per share, plus a 30-day over-allotment option of up to 116,667 shares. Expected net proceeds are ~$2.94 million for working capital and general corporate purposes. The filing contains standard underwriting representations and a 90-day lock-up. As a routine shelf takedown on an effective S-3, this is not a special situation; it is an ordinary capital raise.
